partners.mechanism_chain: Variant in IRF6 —DISRUPTS→ IRF6 (HGNC:24077); IRF6 (HGNC:24077) —LEADS_TO→ Cleft lip and palate (HP:0000218); Variant in IFNGR1 —DISRUPTS→ IFNGR1 (HGNC:5514); IFNGR1 (HGNC:5514) —BINDS→ JAK-STAT signaling pathway (WP:WP400); IRF6 (HGNC:24077) —BINDS→ JAK-STAT signaling pathway (WP:WP400); JAK-STAT signaling pathway (WP:WP400) —LEADS_TO→ Susceptibility to mycobacterial diseases (HP:0002720).
